terms.section1_body: Umuryango is completely free to use for your family workspace. There are no subscription fees, hidden charges, or paid tiers.

terms.section4_title: 4. No Liability (If Anything Happens, Don't Ask Us)
terms.section4_body: This app is provided as-is without warranties of any kind. If anything happens—including data loss, misunderstandings, or family financial disputes—we are not responsible, so please don't ask us!
